system_goal: Contextual AI Motion Graphics & Video Editing System
strict_safety_rules: NEVER inject hardcoded founder names, ages (e.g. 17 years old), or Anas unless explicitly spoken in the transcript.
NEVER inject video editing, Cloud AI, or Full-Stack badges on e-commerce product videos or general content.
ALWAYS extract numbers directly from speech (e.g. 58 for wilayas, 3 for features, 100 for percent).
ALWAYS scale Arabic text dynamically to fit inside card and badge boundaries using get_fitted_arabic_font.
KEEP initial transcription prompts neutral without biasing the acoustic model toward any specific script.
